goal: Staff user can capture courier/device codes, search pending orders, confirm association, and ship from mobile.
stop_condition: Staff H5 and WeChat builds pass or are blocked only by documented environment constraints.
non_goals: Do not implement customer app behavior.
Do not add browser-only DOM APIs.
Do not store third-party credentials in the staff app.
expected_evidence: Staff WeChat Mini Program build output.
Spec-review and quality-review notes for staff touched files.
unsafe_assumptions: Assuming every staff scan has one obvious matching order.
Assuming mobile upload and scan APIs behave identically on H5 and WeChat.
